image_description: A close-up studio shot of an elaborate, vintage-style statement necklace against a plain white background. The necklace features a bib design with multiple dangling, leaf-shaped or petal-shaped pendants made of textured metal (possibly brass or bronze) with green and brown patina/oxidation. These pendants are adorned with inset cabochon gemstones in various colors including teal, amber, purple, and red. The upper portion consists of beaded strands featuring faceted green glass beads and larger square-cut purple stones.
